Preservation observations

On this page: summary and methods

The observed treatment stabilized 16 of 20 sample sheets.

  • Primary outcome: 16 sheets remained intact.
    • Eight of those sheets had no visible discoloration.
    • Eight had minor edge discoloration.
  • Secondary outcome: four sheets required repair.

The archive's search navigation was evaluated separately from preservation.
